title: The timeline ruler names the right time when zoomed in
goal: Zoom the timeline in and scroll along, and every number on the ruler is drawn seconds away from the moment it names: at 4x the label 1:15 sits about four seconds left of 1:15, so an editor lining a cut up against the ruler cuts in the wrong place. The ruler has to agree with the playhead, the clips and the captions at every zoom.
notes: Found by measure-the-video-editor-against-premiere-and-fi (2026-09-24), gap report docs/design/video-vs-premiere.md. Reproduced: open a 5 minute recording, videoSeekQuarter (75 s), give the timeline the keyboard, press = twice. Readout says 0:56 to 2:11, playhead at 1:15 draws at x 587 of the lane, the 1:15 label at x 497 (24.9 pt a second, so about 3.6 s off). Another view (0:01 to 1:16) put 0:15 at the lane start, about 14 s off. Pictures: docs/design/video-vs-premiere/ruler-at-4x.jpg, ruler-at-max-zoom.jpg. Cause, read in code: VideoKit.TimeRuler (Sources/Photonz/VideoKit/VideoKitTimeline.swift ~line 86) lays labels in a ZStack with .alignmentGuide(.leading) { -x }; a ZStack of alignment-guided children is sized to its children, so the leftmost visible tick is pulled to x 0 and every label shifts left by that tick s x. At Fit the first tick is at 0 so nothing shows. Fix is to place labels with .offset/.position in a fixed frame, the way TimelineGridlines does.
acceptance: With the playhead at 1:15 and the timeline at 4x, the playhead line sits on the ruler label 1:15, not four seconds from it
At the deepest zoom, scrolled anywhere, each ruler label sits over the frame it names (checked against the playhead readout)
At Fit, labels sit where they sit today
A walk zooms a long recording in, parks the playhead on a labelled second and checks the label is under it
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Reproduced before touching the ruler: new walk ruler-names-the-right-time-zoomed-walk (Next defaults, no flags) with a new expectTimeline claim that reads where each ruler number was DRAWN (probe-only markers, PlaytestRulerMark.swift). At 4x, 0:56 to 2:11, every number sat 80.6 pt left of its moment (the x of the first visible tick, 1:00), 1:15 drawn at 322.5 pt with the playhead line at 403.0 pt. Fit passed.

Fix: VideoKit.TimeRuler's ZStack gets a clear full-width first child, so the stack's left edge is the lane's and alignment-guided numbers stay where their guides put them. After: 1:15 at 403 with the playhead at 403 (4x); 75s at 403 on playhead 403 (deepest); 225s at 161 on playhead 161 (deepest, further along); Fit unchanged.

Walks passing: ruler-names-the-right-time-zoomed-walk, premiere-keys-on-the-timeline-walk, open-out-the-timeline-walk, an-editing-session-walk, cut-on-the-timeline-walk. Audit queue/audits/2026-09-24-ruler-at-zoom.json with three real captures.

Adversarial pass: a Premiere editor lines cuts up against ruler numbers, so a number drawn off its moment is a wrong cut, not a cosmetic nit; the fix changes no look (mock video.html places each .tk absolutely at its moment, which is now what the app does). Nothing filed: the only rough edge (ruler counts in seconds, not frames) was already seen and deliberately not filed by the Premiere comparison.

Scripts/test.sh: 9549 of 9550 on each of four full runs; the one failure each time was an export-size test (different one each run), the known load flake tracked in the-export-size-test-fails-about-one-run-in-thre. Reproduced that flake on HEAD with this task's code set aside, and the export suites pass alone, so committed on that evidence.

Ruler numbers now sit over their moments at every zoom (VideoKit.TimeRuler pinned to the lane's width). Verified by a new expectTimeline check that reads where the numbers were drawn: at 4x, 1:15 is at 403 pt with the playhead at 403 (was 322.5); at the deepest zoom, 75s and 225s are on the playhead; Fit is unchanged. Walk ruler-names-the-right-time-zoomed-walk at Next defaults; audit queue/audits/2026-09-24-ruler-at-zoom.json with real captures. Commit 2271b8e8.
